title: Graph drawing: projection and SVG (dagre from V0)
what:
- graph/project.js: raw graph JSON -> states [{path, kind}] and edges [{from, to, kind, event}], mirroring jev_graph's projection for flat and compound states, always / on / onDone, and root on (ERROR).
- graph/draw.js: SVG in the TUI look (square boxes, monospace labels, edge labels; classes current, visited, final and failed), laid out with vendor/dagre.js.
tests:
project.test.mjs over all six eidolon-plugins/jev/graphs/*.json:
- wiki-hop gives exactly 4 states (open, reading, arrived, failed)
- its edges: open->reading always; reading->arrived twice, by guard; reading->reading on PICK and EMPTY; *->failed on ERROR
- the other five do not throw
live_check: Rendered inside the graph tab once W2b-1 lands.
